# Fleet v1.4.4 donor custody

These Godot scripts came from the actual delivered
`CyberSand-Fleet-Native-Admission-v1.4.4.zip`, inspected for this mission.

Donor archive SHA-256:
`293f563bf8a86588917451aaf2b7b23648be0a0838aeb3e92fd8ad4908578a70`.

Original native-workbench-admission.gd SHA-256:
`02823acd5683ada3f8a0bdf5b3403b26518bdc6c35101ff48da41d6b23766be8`.

The core Workbench/native/full-grid/Midge/save/reopen methodology is preserved.
Additions bind each receipt to its actual Godot process, active Setup bytes and
saved label, and require the observed W motion to have an upward projection over
20 controlled ticks. Historical owner archives retain their original receipts;
they are not rewritten to claim these later custody/control fields.

No engine source, native binary, map geometry or map-branch program is vendored.
